settings.name: Eamonn P McGrady & Co
settings.about: Eamonn P McGrady & Co is a locally owned chartered accountancy firm with offices in Downpatrick and Newcastle, County Down. Its published services cover accountancy, audit and taxation for individuals, businesses and charities. The firm describes more than 30 years of experience and a personal service tailored to each client.
